project.name: fintech-banking-core-payment-gateway
project.description: Payment gateway ledger backend (Spring Boot 4) with Next.js admin portal

tasks.title: Spring profile config: H2 dev profile with console, datasource and JPA settings
tasks.notes: application.properties is bare; add dev/prod profiles, H2 console, open-in-view off, SQL logging in dev

tasks.title: REST API: merchants CRUD endpoints with validation and error handling
tasks.notes: POST/GET /api/merchants, DTOs, RestControllerAdvice error format per system-design.md

tasks.title: REST API: payments and transaction ledger endpoints
tasks.notes: POST/GET /api/payments, POST /api/payments/{id}/transactions, idempotency by idempotencyKey, 409 on illegal transitions

tasks.title: API-key auth filter for merchant endpoints (X-API-Key)

tasks.title: Admin portal: connect to backend API (merchants and payments views)
